answers.how: The small bird moves about 836 px/s and the big bird about 1368 px/s. Thus 11 × 1368/836 ≈ 18.0.
Extrapolating the tracked positions to 0.300 s gives a separation of about 753 px. Using 11/836 meters per pixel gives 9.9 m.
The big bird is about 65 px long. Multiplying by the calibrated scale, 11/836 m/px, gives about 0.86 m.
The small bird is about 39 px long. Multiplying by the calibrated scale, 11/836 m/px, gives about 0.51 m.
